apks.help: Download ProjectHoneydew2-*-quest.apk from the Project Honeydew site and pick the file.

inputs.label: Pikmin 2 disc image (USA or Europe)
inputs.help: Your own Pikmin 2 GameCube disc image, USA (GPVE01) or Europe (GPVP01), as a plain .iso or .gcm. Unpack .7z or .zip first, and convert RVZ, WIA, GCZ, CISO or NKit images to ISO with Dolphin.

steps.text: Open Project Honeydew 2 from Library > Unknown Sources, choose your disc image and wait a minute or two while it imports. Afterwards you can delete the image. Uninstalling the app deletes its saves.

notes: APK only on projecthoneydew.com. No disc check: two game IDs (GPVE01, GPVP01) are accepted and the schema takes one. Installs beside Project Honeydew (pikmin-vr) as its own app.
